meta.tool: Playwright chromium, viewport 1440x900, deviceScaleFactor 2; custom in-page probe (computed styles, offsetHeight so CSS transforms do not distort sizes except where noted)
notes: All numbers are computed CSS px as rendered at 1440 wide, unless a frame is marked scaled.

Several sites render their fake UI at a CSS transform scale: Attio hero frame 0.995 (scrolls from 0.95), Mercury spend visuals and Stripe Billing/Connect visuals (font sizes 8-10px rendered). Those frames report rendered sizes, not designed sizes.

Many product visuals are raster or video, not DOM: Ramp (video + imgix raster), Untitled UI home (3024x2016 PNG), Mercury (webp), Vercel home (webp), AlignUI Pro template carousel (1600x1200 PNG). Only their wrapper recipe (radius, border, padding, shadow, crop) is measured; internals are read visually.
tailwindcss.com/plus redirects to /plus/login (gated). Catalyst UI Kit marketing page (catalyst.tailwindui.com) was measured instead.
pill = any element 16-64px high with text or icon, radius/bg/border/ring, <=14 descendants. h = offsetHeight, rad in px, "pill" = fully rounded.

Hover tooltips on Vercel/Untitled UI charts could not be triggered (static or Recharts needing real pointer path); tooltip numbers come from Raycast DOM, AlignUI kit docs (alignui-system.md) and visual reads.
